name: ara
description: Set up and operate an Ara workspace from Codex through Ara MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and operate your Ara workspace.
interface.longDescription: Uses Ara's workspace-scoped OAuth MCP connection to configure repositories, environments, secrets, MCP servers, skills, and cloud coding sessions.
defaultPrompt: Set up this repository in Ara and prove it with a fresh acceptance session.
Import this repository's environment and MCP configuration into Ara.
Hand this bounded coding task to Ara and monitor it.
Upload this workflow as an Ara team skill for future sessions.
